name: Westminster grounds, former footprint
summary: Former footprint occupied by grass and a mature tree in the 2025 aerial. A light-coloured house appears roughly in that direction in 2019, with identity unconfirmed.

evidence.note: Open grass and bare branches extend across the notched polygon in 2025.
March 2019 street image includes a low light house beyond the lawn in the direction of the footprint.
P50 6.31 m, P90 13.46 m and peak 15.72 m. Tree cover and the newer orthophoto preclude a reliable current eave height.

notes: The survey models the landscape shown in the 2025 orthophoto. The former building has no established name or facade finish.
